description: This Swift source file defines a configuration management module for the OpenClaw macOS application. It provides functions to load, save, and manipulate configuration data stored in JSON files, as well as to read metadata and perform consistency checks. The code also handles logging configuration-related events and anomalies, and references external files like audit logs and health state files.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL for the configuration file.

methods.name: stateDirURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for the directory containing state files.

methods.name: defaultWorkspaceURL
methods.description: Returns the default workspace URL.

methods.name: loadDict
methods.description: Loads the configuration from the JSON file into a dictionary.

methods.name: saveDict
methods.description: Saves the provided dictionary as the configuration JSON file.

methods.name: loadGatewayDict
methods.description: Loads the 'gateway' section of the configuration.

methods.name: updateGatewayDict
methods.description: Modifies the 'gateway' section using a mutate closure and saves it.

methods.name: browserControlEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether browser control is enabled from the config.

methods.name: setBrowserControlEnabled
methods.description: Sets the browser control enabled flag in the config.

methods.name: agentWorkspace
methods.description: Retrieves the agent workspace setting.

methods.name: setAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Updates the agent workspace setting.

methods.name: gatewayPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the gateway password from the config.

methods.name: gatewayPort
methods.description: Returns the port number for the gateway.

methods.name: remoteGatewayPort
methods.description: Returns the port of the remote gateway URL if set.

methods.name: setRemoteGatewayUrl
methods.description: Sets the remote gateway URL with specified host and port.

methods.name: clearRemoteGatewayUrl
methods.description: Removes the remote gateway URL from config.

methods.name: hostKey
methods.description: Generates a normalized host key for comparison.

methods.name: parseConfigData
methods.description: Parses JSON data into a dictionary, attempts JSON5 decoding if needed.

methods.name: stampMeta
methods.description: Adds metadata such as version and timestamp to config.

methods.name: hasMeta
methods.description: Checks whether the config has a 'meta' section.

methods.name: gatewayMode
methods.description: Retrieves the gateway mode string.

methods.name: configWriteSuspiciousReasons
methods.description: Determines if the config write operation is suspicious based on size, metadata, and gateway mode.

methods.name: configAuditLogURL
methods.description: Returns URL for the configuration audit log.

methods.name: configHealthStateURL
methods.description: Returns URL for the config health state file.

methods.name: readConfigHealthState
methods.description: Reads current health state info from disk.

methods.name: writeConfigHealthState
methods.description: Writes health state info to disk.

methods.name: configHealthEntry
methods.description: Retrieves health info for a specific config path.

methods.name: setConfigHealthEntry
methods.description: Sets health info for a specific config path.

methods.name: isUpdateChannelOnlyRoot
methods.description: Checks if the config is an update channel only root.

methods.name: fileTimestampMs
methods.description: Converts file attribute date to milliseconds timestamp.

methods.name: fileAttributeInt
methods.description: Extracts integer value from file attribute data.

methods.name: fileSystemNumber
methods.description: Converts a number to string representation for file system attributes.

methods.name: posixMode
methods.description: Extracts POSIX mode bits from file permissions.

methods.name: configFingerprint
methods.description: Computes fingerprint data (hash, size, timestamp, metadata info) for a config file.

methods.name: sameFingerprint
methods.description: Compares two fingerprints for equality.

methods.name: observeSuspiciousReasons
methods.description: Analyzes reasons why a config might be suspicious (size drop, missing meta, etc).

methods.name: readConfigFingerprint
methods.description: Reads and computes fingerprint info for a file at path.

methods.name: configTimestampToken
methods.description: Converts a timestamp string into a safe filename token.

methods.name: persistClobberedSnapshot
methods.description: Saves a snapshot of a clobbered config for diagnostics.

methods.name: observeConfigRead
methods.description: Handles logic after reading a config, logs anomalies, updates health state.

methods.name: appendConfigWriteAudit
methods.description: Appends a write event record to the audit log.

methods.name: appendConfigObserveAudit
methods.description: Appends a config observe event record to the audit log.
